response.overview: The Tharu people are the indigenous community of the Chitwan region, part of Nepal’s Terai lowlands. They proudly identify as "The People of the Forest," reflecting their historical and ongoing connection to the natural environment. This immersive, dialogue-guided film follows Asma Ram Mahto, 84, as he navigates the growing thresholds between himself and the forest of his home. The film’s emotional core lies in Aasma Ram’s quiet determination to remember and guard the old wisdom passed to the community and to listen to the land’s fading whispers before they’re gone forever.
response.title: What The Land Remembers
